about.headline: Your technology partner from network cable to custom software.
about.body: SIROTECH Kft. — a Székesfehérvár-based IT and security technology partner — brings together managed IT and systems administration services, CCTV and alarm installation, bespoke software development, and electrical works under a single legal entity and service contract. No coordination overhead between vendors — one team, one point of contact, full accountability.

team.headline: Who we are
team.body:
SIROTECH is led by Dávid Skoda and Tamás Tóth. We have been working in IT and security technology since 2021 — following experience gained in manufacturing and multinational environments. Operating as an independent company since 2023, and as SIROTECH Informatikai és Biztonságtechnikai Kft. from 2026.

Today we provide the technology backbone for more than 25 businesses across four specialisations. We personally carry out all assessments and work — no intermediaries, no subcontracting.
